json_ld.name: Ergonomic Chair Pro
json_ld.description: A new era of ergonomics has arrived. Introducing Ergonomic Chair Pro, an unrivaled seating experience backed by half a decade of research, development, and testing with people who embody a wide variety of support needs and work styles. Designed by Branch in San Francisco, Ergonomic Chair Pro was meticulously (re)designed with the feedback of thousands of customers. It offers better customization, build quality, and materials to support productivity and well-being in the home, workplace, and anywhere work is done.Led by designer Jesse Menayan, we wanted to create a flagship chair that not only matched but improved on the comfort and materiality of chairs that are twice the price. With 14 points of adjustment, an improved headrest, and an optional tall cylinder, Ergonomic Chair Pro offers superlative adjustability to fit every body. A choice of luxurious materials completes your daily sit, including super soft performance mesh, textured bouclé, durable vegan leather, or semi-aniline leather. Ergonomic Chair Pro is the culmination of our commitment to democratizing comfort and productivity in the workplace.

mainEntity.name: What are the differences between the Ergonomic Chair and the Ergonomic Chair Pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ergonomic Chair Pro offers more adjustments, upgraded lumbar support, and premium material options. It’s designed for all-day comfort with added customization and enhanced support.

mainEntity.name: Do ergonomic chairs help with back or posture issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ergonomic chairs feature adjustment points that support proper seated posture. The Ergonomic Chair Pro includes padded lumbar support and customizable armrests, so you can fine-tune your setup.

mainEntity.name: Is a mesh or cushion chair better for long sitting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mesh and cushion chairs both offer ergonomic support. Mesh is breathable and helps regulate temperature, while cushions provide a softer seat. The Ergonomic Chair Pro offers a breathable mesh back with a comfortable cushion seat.

mainEntity.name: What materials are used in the Ergonomic Chair Pro’s construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ergonomic Chair Pro is made with a powder-coated aluminum base, high-density foam cushioning, and your choice of fine-weave mesh, vegan leather, or premium leather upholstery.

review.name: Simple Storage with clean lines
review.reviewBody:
I purchased the Storklinta 3-drawer dresser because my bedroom desperately needed some extra storage—and, honestly, a little life. The room felt so barren and unfinished, and this simple piece ended up making a bigger difference than I expected.

Assembly was surprisingly easy, the clean and simple design is beautiful, and the drawers are a great size for holding everything I needed. It adds just the right amount of warmth and functionality without overwhelming the room.

Sometimes it’s the simplest pieces that make a space finally start to feel like home. ❤️

review.name: Assembly is awful
review.reviewBody: Way too many parts.  Took me a very long time to assemble this.  Not a fan of the assembly.  The instructions should also have words!

review.name: Disappointing
review.reviewBody:
I gave this chest of drawers 3 stars because I got it put together. It looks okay, and the drawers work. The workmanship was poor, however. Specific problems included: (1) a drawer bottom so warped that I had trouble fitting it into the grooves in the front and back of the drawer. Squaring it up with the drawer rails helped, but the drawer is not as solid as it should be; (2) 2 out of 3 drawer backs with defective holes for the drawer support bracket. One was missing a hole, which had to be drilled. The other had a hole so close the groove that the metal bracket broke through when hammered in; and (3) holes in the bottom board of the case that did not line up with the holes in the backing board.

The glass top was also a shock. I had been told in the store that it came with glass spacers. Instead it came with 3 holes along one edge and ugly metal brackets to attach it to the chest. 

We were considering buying other IKEA pieces but will not do so after this experience.

mainEntity.name: What makes a rug good for office chairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: A great rug for office chair use needs a low pile so wheels roll smoothly without snagging. Ours also have a slip-resistant backing to stay in place, even with constant movement, making them ideal for rolling chairs and active work setups.

mainEntity.name: What size rug is best for a home office setup?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your layout. For small desks or , a  or  rug works well. For larger offices with more furniture, a  helps anchor the entire workspace. Just make sure the rug extends beyond your desk and chair to allow free movement.
